question: In the initial evaluation of all traumatized patients in coma, which of the following radiographs are essential even if these locations do not appear to be symptomatic?

options.opa: Anterior-posterior skull X-ray and pelvic anteroposterior RX.
options.opb: Anterior-posterior RX of both femurs and axial RX of pelvis.
options.opc: Lateral RX of the cervical spine and anteroposterior RX of the pelvis.
options.opd: Lateral RX of the cervical spine and lateral RX of the lumbar spine.
